evidence.detail: Return shape changed from {amount, tax} to {net, tax, currency}; the renamed net property is consumed by both callers, and the added currency field is additive.
Destructures { net, currency: quotedCurrency } from pricing.quote, matching the new return shape exactly.
Accesses pricing.quote(price, 0.1, "CNY").net, which still exists after the rename, so this pre-existing caller remains valid.
Test only asserts Number.isFinite(invoiceNet(100)), which depends on .net and remains satisfied.
